title: cheer — fallacy

phrases.translation: 使高兴；高兴起来；使振奋
让你振作起来，让你开心起来；让你舒畅些

sentences.sentence: A great cheer went up from the crowd.
sentences.translation: 人群中爆发出巨大的欢呼声。

sentences.sentence: So let’s give a cheer to the kids who passed their exams.
sentences.translation: 那么我们为通过考试的孩子们欢呼吧。

sentences.sentence: The final whistle was greeted with triumphant cheers from players and spectators.
sentences.translation: 终场的哨声迎来了运动员和观众胜利的欢呼。

sentences.sentence: The jagged stratification of Jedburgh, so different than the smooth schist-and-sandstone layering seen elsewhere in Scotland, would provide it.
sentences.translation: 而赫顿不整合结构正好佐证了这种观点，这处位于杰德堡的交错岩层完全不同于在苏格兰其他地区所发现的光滑片岩和砂岩层结构。

sentences.sentence: Below are two more striking varieties of schist .
sentences.translation: 下面是两个比较突出的品种片岩。

sentences.sentence: That suit of schist contans a large number of abundant aluminium mineral: staurolite, almandine and biotite, so the primitive is mostly clayrock.
sentences.translation: 该套片岩主要由富铝矿物十字石、铁铝榴石和大量黑云母组成，因而其原岩以粘土岩为主。

sentences.sentence: She was interviewed about the death of the Thai worker on Israeli TV and she plans to continue to work for peace.
sentences.translation: 她接受了以色列电视台关于这位泰国工人致死的报道，并且她计划继续致力于为和平而工作。

sentences.sentence: If the consensus is that you should continue, then I will support the government loyally from the backbenches.
sentences.translation: 如果一致意见是你应该继续留任，那么我会以一名普通议员的身份忠诚地支持政府。

sentences.sentence: Eighteenth-century prints caricature George III as a farmer, laugh at Hanoverian German accents – yet the same crowds who laughed at the printshop windows turned out loyally for coronations.
sentences.translation: 18世纪出版的讽刺漫画农民乔治三世，嘲弄汉诺威的德国口音，然而对着印刷品橱窗大笑的人群转过身就对加冕礼表现出绝对的忠诚。

sentences.sentence: ...a cabaret artiste.
sentences.translation: ...一名“卡巴莱”餐馆艺人。

sentences.sentence: Say I have an online resource that I want you to symbolically pay for.
sentences.translation: 比如，我有一个在线资源，希望您能象征性地为其付出代价。

sentences.sentence: In order to have language, any language, you need to be able to think symbolically.
sentences.translation: 为了有语言，无论任何语言，你需要能够象征性地思想。

sentences.sentence: Thinking symbolically is the foundation of everything we do — we live in a symbolic world.
sentences.translation: 象征性思维是我们做一切的基础，我们生活在一个符号的世界里。

translations.translation: 可管理的, 可控制的

phrases.translation: 可调螺距螺旋桨；可变螺距螺旋桨；调距螺旋桨；可掂螺旋桨

sentences.sentence: Diabetes is a serious but controllable disease.
sentences.translation: 糖尿病是一种严重但可以控制的疾病。

sentences.sentence: Can you state categorically that her death was caused by lack of food?
sentences.translation: 你能明确地说她是饿死的吗？

sentences.translation: 一头多年来智胜猎人的狼

sentences.sentence: Philosophy is a study that lets us be unhappy more intelligently.
sentences.translation: 哲学是让我们更聪明地不快乐的一门学问。

sentences.sentence: Maybe your relationships will be your primary focus for a period of life, as well as learning how to cultivate them more intimately and intelligently.
sentences.translation: 或许生活中的一段时期，你的主要焦点是人际关系，了解怎样聪明地培养人际亲密关系成为了关注点。

sentences.sentence: The reforms could turn out to be highly problematic .
sentences.translation: 改革最终可能会困难重重。

translations.translation: 辗转不安, 烦躁不安

sentences.translation: 稍后她热情地写到了他的风度与举止。

sentences.translation: 他猛地抓住一根柱子作支撑。

sentences.sentence: Tom fell to the ground clutching his stomach.
sentences.translation: 汤姆捂着肚子倒在地上。

sentences.sentence: One day, a man named He Shi of the State of Chu got a piece of uncarved jade in a hill. He quickly went to present it to King Li of the State of Chu.
sentences.translation: 一天，有个叫“和氏”的楚国人，在一座山里得到一块没有雕琢过得玉石，连忙拿去献给楚厉王。

sentences.sentence: Now, two macaque monkeys may have helped MIT researchers solve the time tracking puzzle.
sentences.translation: 现在，两只短尾猿或许可以帮助这些研究人员们解开时间谜团。

sentences.sentence: Soon the villagers couldn't afford to buy food for themselves.
sentences.translation: 很快村民们就买不起吃的东西了。

sentences.sentence: It’s a common fallacy that a neutered dog will become fat and lazy.
sentences.translation: 说阉割过的狗会变得又胖又懒，这是普遍的谬见。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 370 单元

cheer
音标：英 /tʃɪə/  美 /tʃɪr/
n& v. 欢呼
短语：cheer up — 使高兴；高兴起来；使振奋
短语：cheer for — 为…欢呼，喝彩；给…加油
短语：good cheer — n. 勇气；兴高采烈
短语：cheer you up — 让你振作起来，让你开心起来；让你舒畅些
短语：cheer on — 鼓励，为某人打气
例句：A great cheer went up from the crowd.
人群中爆发出巨大的欢呼声。
例句：So let’s give a cheer to the kids who passed their exams.
那么我们为通过考试的孩子们欢呼吧。
例句：The final whistle was greeted with triumphant cheers from players and spectators.
终场的哨声迎来了运动员和观众胜利的欢呼。

schist
音标：英 /ʃɪst/  美 /ʃɪst/
n. [地]片岩
短语：mica schist — 云母片岩
例句：The jagged stratification of Jedburgh, so different than the smooth schist-and-sandstone layering seen elsewhere in Scotland, would provide it.
而赫顿不整合结构正好佐证了这种观点，这处位于杰德堡的交错岩层完全不同于在苏格兰其他地区所发现的光滑片岩和砂岩层结构。
例句：Below are two more striking varieties of schist .
下面是两个比较突出的品种片岩。
例句：That suit of schist contans a large number of abundant aluminium mineral: staurolite, almandine and biotite, so the primitive is mostly clayrock.
该套片岩主要由富铝矿物十字石、铁铝榴石和大量黑云母组成，因而其原岩以粘土岩为主。

Thai
音标：英 /taɪ/  美 /taɪ/
n. 泰国人, 泰国语
短语：thai restaurant — 泰式餐厅；泰国菜馆
短语：thai boxing — 泰国拳
例句：She was interviewed about the death of the Thai worker on Israeli TV and she plans to continue to work for peace.
她接受了以色列电视台关于这位泰国工人致死的报道，并且她计划继续致力于为和平而工作。

rime
音标：英 /raɪm/  美 /raɪm/
n. 结晶, v使蒙霜

loyally
adv. 忠诚
例句：If the consensus is that you should continue, then I will support the government loyally from the backbenches.
如果一致意见是你应该继续留任，那么我会以一名普通议员的身份忠诚地支持政府。
例句：Eighteenth-century prints caricature George III as a farmer, laugh at Hanoverian German accents – yet the same crowds who laughed at the printshop windows turned out loyally for coronations.
18世纪出版的讽刺漫画农民乔治三世，嘲弄汉诺威的德国口音，然而对着印刷品橱窗大笑的人群转过身就对加冕礼表现出绝对的忠诚。

artiste
音标：英 /ɑː'tiːst/  美 /ɑr'tist/
n. 技艺家
例句：...a cabaret artiste.
...一名“卡巴莱”餐馆艺人。

symbolically
音标：英 /sim'bɔlikəli/  美 /sim'bɔlikəli/
adv. 象征(性)地
例句：Say I have an online resource that I want you to symbolically pay for.
比如，我有一个在线资源，希望您能象征性地为其付出代价。
例句：In order to have language, any language, you need to be able to think symbolically.
为了有语言，无论任何语言，你需要能够象征性地思想。
例句：Thinking symbolically is the foundation of everything we do — we live in a symbolic world.
象征性思维是我们做一切的基础，我们生活在一个符号的世界里。

misinterprete
v. 误解

controllable
音标：英 /kən'trəʊləbl/  美 /kən'troləbl/
adj. 可管理的, 可控制的
短语：controllable pitch propeller — 可调螺距螺旋桨；可变螺距螺旋桨；调距螺旋桨；可掂螺旋桨
短语：controllable pitch — 可变螺距；可调桨
例句：Diabetes is a serious but controllable disease.
糖尿病是一种严重但可以控制的疾病。

categorically
音标：英 /,kæti'gɔrikli/  美 /,kæti'gɔrikli/
adv. 断然地, 明确地
例句：Can you state categorically that her death was caused by lack of food?
你能明确地说她是饿死的吗？

outwit
音标：英 /aʊt'wɪt/  美 /,aʊt'wɪt/
v. 瞒骗, 以智取胜
例句：a wolf that had outwitted hunters for years
一头多年来智胜猎人的狼

intelligently
adv. 聪明地；理智地
例句：Philosophy is a study that lets us be unhappy more intelligently.
哲学是让我们更聪明地不快乐的一门学问。
例句：Maybe your relationships will be your primary focus for a period of life, as well as learning how to cultivate them more intimately and intelligently.
或许生活中的一段时期，你的主要焦点是人际关系，了解怎样聪明地培养人际亲密关系成为了关注点。

problematic
音标：英 /prɒblə'mætɪk/  美 /'prɑblə'mætɪk/
adj. 问题的, 有疑问的
例句：The reforms could turn out to be highly problematic .
改革最终可能会困难重重。

restlessness
音标：英 /ˈrestlɪsnɪs/  美 /rɛstlɪsnɪs/
n. 辗转不安, 烦躁不安

bearing
音标：英 /'beərɪŋ/  美 /'bɛrɪŋ/
n. 举止，风度
短语：bearing capacity — 承载量；结果能力；产仔能力
短语：ball bearing — 滚珠，钢球；滚珠轴承
短语：roller bearing — 滚柱轴承
短语：load bearing — 承载；承重
短语：rolling bearing — 滚动轴承
短语：bearing steel — 轴承钢；滚珠轴承钢
短语：ultimate bearing capacity — 极限承载力，极限承载量；轴承极限能力，承载量
短语：magnetic bearing — （电）磁向位
短语：oil bearing — 含油的；含油轴承
短语：thrust bearing — 推力轴承；止推轴承
短语：direct bearing — 导向轴承
短语：gas bearing — 含气的；气体轴承；含瓦斯的
短语：main bearing — 主轴承
短语：sliding bearing — 滑动轴承
短语：journal bearing — 径向轴承
短语：load bearing capacity — 负荷能力；载重能力
短语：bearing structure — 承载结构，承重结构；支承结构；推力轴承结构
短语：rubber bearing — 橡胶轴承
短语：gold bearing — 含金的
短语：bearing load — 轴承负荷
例句：She later wrote warmly of his bearing and behaviour.
稍后她热情地写到了他的风度与举止。

clutch
音标：英 /klʌtʃ/  美 /klʌtʃ/
v. 抓住, 攫住
短语：in the clutch — [口语]在关键时刻
短语：electromagnetic clutch — 电磁离合器
短语：clutch at — 抓住
短语：friction clutch — 摩擦离合器
短语：automobile clutch — 汽车离合器
短语：clutch disc — 离合器片；离合圆盘
短语：clutch pedal — 离合器踏板；离合皮板
短语：clutch cover — 离合器盖
短语：overrunning clutch — 单向离合器；超速离合器
短语：clutch plate — 离合器片，从动盘
短语：safety clutch — 过载离合器，安全离合器
短语：automatic clutch — 自动离合器
短语：clutch brake — 离合器制动器；离合脾；离合器煞车
短语：clutch assembly — 离合器总成
短语：clutch housing — 离合器壳
短语：clutch disk — 离合器
例句：He clutched at a pillar for support.
他猛地抓住一根柱子作支撑。
例句：Tom fell to the ground clutching his stomach.
汤姆捂着肚子倒在地上。

uncarved
adj. 没雕刻的
例句：One day, a man named He Shi of the State of Chu got a piece of uncarved jade in a hill. He quickly went to present it to King Li of the State of Chu.
一天，有个叫“和氏”的楚国人，在一座山里得到一块没有雕琢过得玉石，连忙拿去献给楚厉王。

macaque
音标：英 /mə'kɑːk; -'kæk/  美 /mə'kɑk/
n. 短尾猿
例句：Now, two macaque monkeys may have helped MIT researchers solve the time tracking puzzle.
现在，两只短尾猿或许可以帮助这些研究人员们解开时间谜团。

villager
音标：英 /'vɪlɪdʒə/  美 /'vɪlɪdʒɚ/
n. 村民
例句：Soon the villagers couldn't afford to buy food for themselves.
很快村民们就买不起吃的东西了。

fallacy
音标：英 /'fæləsɪ/  美 /'fæləsi/
n. 谬误, 谬论
例句：It’s a common fallacy that a neutered dog will become fat and lazy.
说阉割过的狗会变得又胖又懒，这是普遍的谬见。
